preregistration.brief_condition_verbatim: Pass if the two-sided value is inside [0.4, 0.6] for the representative seed and the 20-seed mean is inside it.
preregistration.operationalisation: For each classifier (metadata, content) at each positive share (0.2, 0.5): random labels drawn with seeds 20261020..20261039 (20 seeds); representative seed = 20261020 (declared before running). Two-sided value = max(AUROC, 1 - AUROC) from grouping_measure.leak_classifier (5-fold cross-validated AUROC). Pass for a classifier-share cell iff (a) the representative seed's two-sided value <= 0.6 (equivalently AUROC in [0.4, 0.6]) AND (b) the mean over the 20 seeds of the two-sided value <= 0.6. The mean AUROC (one-sided) is also reported and must lie in [0.4, 0.6]. Rung 2 leak line passes iff all four cells pass; otherwise kill 'null classifier off'.

post_hoc_permutation_band.label: POST-HOC (added after the pre-registered verdict; does not change it)
post_hoc_permutation_band.purpose: calibrated null band for the rung 3 and 4 leak gate (design amendment proposal)
post_hoc_permutation_band.metadata_bias_note: The metadata classifier's mean AUROC at share 0.2 sits 2.8 standard errors below 0.5 over the 20 pre-registered seeds (0.436) and 1.7 standard errors below 0.5 over the 200 band seeds (0.489), the known negative bias of cross-validated AUROC under random labels: in each of the 5 stratified folds the held-out positives are removed from the training positives, so the fitted positive direction is estimated from the other positives only and points away from the held-out ones (and the fold-specific intercepts are pooled into one ranking), which pushes held-out positives below held-out negatives on average; the effect grows as positives per fold shrink (about 5 per fold at 24 positives).

post_hoc_recommendation: Future runs: draw folds and bootstrap from seed + a fixed offset (for example `--fold-seed-offset 777777`), never from the label seed itself, so the label draw and the fold permutation are independent streams.

At pilot size (n = 27 to 36 account-days) the fixed 0.6 gate kills a clean world 0.39 to 0.61 of the time under per-row labels; a calibrated 5 percent gate there is a two-sided value of 0.738 to 0.874, so only a strong leak is detectable at that size.

With labels per account (whole accounts positive across days, as a pilot plants them) and cross-validation not grouped by account, the content classifier's null mean AUROC is 0.634 (metadata 0.525): the content classifier is biased upward by account identity, because the same account's other days sit in the training folds. Any calibrated gate for rungs 3 and 4 must therefore be drawn either (a) with account-level labels under the same ungrouped protocol, or (b) with grouped-by-account cross-validation (all of an account's days in one fold), which removes the identity shortcut; the controller chooses.

post_hoc_fold_seed_sensitivity.label: POST-HOC (added after the pre-registered verdict; does not change it)
post_hoc_fold_seed_sensitivity.flip_sentence: Under an arbitrary change of the fold seed (label seed + 777777, labels unchanged) the same pre-registered rule passes all four primary cells, so the pre-registered KILL sits at the noise floor of the gate rather than signalling a broken classifier.
post_hoc_fold_seed_sensitivity.residue_sentence: Residue on the two-complete-days unit at this offset: metadata@0.2 (representative seed 0.641, 20-seed mean 0.488, mean two-sided 0.570) still fails the pre-registered rule.
